mentions.name: Knowable
mentions.description: A visually grounded AI tutoring application, built to improve on the concept of an AI tutor beyond a simple chatbox interaction.
mentions.problem: AI tutors today are typically just chatboxes; this project aims to make the concept of an AI tutor better than that.

A visually grounded AI tutoring application: https://knowable.ca
